scale_method: Scale bar from drawings: Floor 1 is 1.0 inch = 40.0 feet (1:480), Floors 2 and 3 are 1.0 inch = 30.0 feet (1:360). Standard exterior doors calibrated to ~0.9 m to 1.8 m double doors.

floors.notes: Level 100 DCC floor plan containing media production studios, WRPI radio station, IT / telecomm facilities, mechanical rooms, and stair cores.
Level 200 contains classrooms DCC 232, 235, 236, 239, 240, CDC offices and conference room, central storage, and openings underneath the sloped tiered lecture halls above.

Level 300 is the main auditorium and lecture concourse floor featuring DCC 308 (grand lecture hall/auditorium), tiered lecture halls 318, 324, 330, and 337, main entrance vestibules/exits to campus along the south curtain wall, and interview suites.

global_notes: Darrin Communications Center (RPI) aligned across 3 levels. Tiered lecture halls 308, 318, 324, 330, and 337 occupy a double-height volume spanning Levels 200 and 300 with primary entrances from the Level 300 concourse. Level 100 sits into the grade with television studios, radio facilities, and media labs. Primary vertical circulation relies on Stair 1ST1/2ST1/3ST1 on the south facade, northeast and northwest stair towers, and elevator 1-E/2-E/3-E in the north-central core.
